scripts.devlink: corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm --dir devlink add --global .
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run test-packages && corepack pnpm run test-compile && corepack pnpm run test-rojo && corepack pnpm run test-run
scripts.test-compile: corepack pnpm run test-typecheck && vp test run --coverage
scripts.test-roblox: corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run test-compile && corepack pnpm run test-rojo && corepack pnpm run run-in-roblox
scripts.check: corepack pnpm run lint && corepack pnpm run fmt:check && corepack pnpm run lint-packages
scripts.lint-packages: corepack pnpm --filter @roblox-ts/luau-ast run build && corepack pnpm --filter create-roblox-ts run eslint && corepack pnpm --filter vscode-roblox-ts --filter eslint-plugin-roblox-ts run lint
scripts.test-packages: corepack pnpm --filter @roblox-ts/path-translator --filter @roblox-ts/rojo-resolver --filter @roblox-ts/ts-expose-internals --filter create-roblox-ts --filter roblox-ts-extensions --filter vscode-roblox-ts run test && corepack pnpm --filter eslint-plugin-roblox-ts run typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter eslint-plugin-roblox-ts run test --run && corepack pnpm --filter eslint-plugin-roblox-ts run test:fixtures
scripts.package-vscode: corepack pnpm --filter vscode-roblox-ts... run build && corepack pnpm --filter vscode-roblox-ts run package
